chunks: Everything in it that is from Sulayman ibn Khalid al-Bajali, I have narrated from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Sulayman ibn Khalid al-Bajali al-Aqta' al-Kufi.
And he had gone out with Zayd ibn Ali عليه السلام, then he escaped.

key_terms.الْأَقْطَعِ: A descriptive epithet, here part of the narrator’s identifying title.
key_terms.الْبَجَلِيِّ: A nisbah identifying Sulayman as belonging to Bajilah.
key_terms.الْكُوفِيِّ: A nisbah indicating that he was from Kufah.
key_terms.زَيْدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: The Imamzādah and leader with whom Sulayman ibn Khalid went out.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Sulayman ibn Khalid al-Bajali in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which al-Shaykh al-Saduq transmits reports from Sulayman ibn Khalid al-Bajali in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih. It also gives a brief biographical note that Sulayman ibn Khalid participated in the movement of Zayd ibn Ali عليه السلام and survived.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Everything in this book that is narrated from Sulayman ibn Khalid Al-Bajali has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Sulayman ibn Khalid Al-Bajali Al-Aqta' Al-Kufi.
He had joined Zayd ibn Ali (as) in his uprising but managed to escape.
